integrity: The proof is a formal consequence of the published Göttsche--de Cataldo product via logarithmic differentiation and an elementary gcd argument. A standalone exact-integer checker independently constructs truncated Euler-product coefficients and verifies both the recurrence and the divisibility. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Only compactly supported topological Euler characteristics of Hilbert schemes of points on smooth complex algebraic surfaces are constrained. Exact valuations, individual Betti/Hodge numbers, refined genera, singular surfaces, and higher-dimensional Hilbert schemes are outside scope.
title: A universal gcd-divisibility law for Euler characteristics of Hilbert schemes of points
